title: anthyllis arenaria
intro: Anthyllis arenaria, commonly known as Kidney Vetch, is a perennial legume plant native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to help with kidney issues, urinary problems, and as a diuretic to aid in the relief of water retention and swelling. The therapeutic actions of Anthyllis arenaria are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe and protect the kidneys and urinary tract. The bioactive constituents of Anthyllis arenaria include flavonoids, saponins, and other compounds that contribute to its therapeutic effects.
